lines: Ye tera ghar, ye mera ghar, kisi ko dekhna ho gar,
To pehle aake maang le, meri nazar, teri nazar.
couplets.en: Anyone who wishes to see this home of yours and mine must first borrow our eyes.

couplets.en: This home of yours and mine is beautiful.

lines: Na baadalon ki chhaaon mein,
Na chaandni ke gaaon mein.
couplets.en: Our home lies neither in the shade of clouds nor in a village of moonlight.

lines: Na phool jaise raaste,
Bane hain iske vaaste.
couplets.en: No paths as lovely as flowers were laid for it.

lines: Magar ye ghar ajeeb hai, zameen ke qareeb hai.
Ye eent pattharon ka ghar, hamari hasraton ka ghar.
couplets.en: Yet there is something rare about this home, close to the earth and made of brick and stone and all we long for.

lines: Jo chaandni nahin to kya?
Ye roshni hai pyaar ki, ye roshni hai pyaar ki.
couplets.en: What need have we of moonlight when love gives us light?

lines: Jo chaandni nahin to kya, ye roshni hai pyaar ki.
Dilon ke phool khil gaye, to fikr kya bahaar ki?
couplets.en: When love lights the room and flowers bloom in our hearts, who needs moonlight or spring?

lines: Hamare ghar na aayegi kabhi khushi udhaar ki.
Hamari raahaton ka ghar, hamari chaahaton ka ghar.
couplets.en: Borrowed joy will never cross the threshold of this home where our comforts and longings live.

lines: Yahaan mahak wafaon ki,
Mohabbaton ka rang hai, mohabbaton ka rang hai.
couplets.en: Here the air carries the scent of devotion and everything takes on the color of love.

lines: Mohabbaton ka rang hai, mohabbaton ka rang hai.
Ye ghar tumhara khwaab hai, ye ghar meri umang hai.
couplets.en: Love colors this home, which holds your dream and all my hope.

lines: Na aarzoo pe qaid hai,
Na hausle pe zang hai.
couplets.en: Desire goes free here, and courage gathers no rust.
